_comment: Feature IDs an operator may turn off at startup with AGENT_CANVAS_FEATURES / AGENT_CANVAS_FEATURES_FILE. Read by scripts/feature-policy.mjs to validate a policy, and published so backends can honor the same IDs. Each description lists exactly the UI elements the ID hides today. IDs are stable: never rename one; mark a retired ID deprecated instead. Keep FEATURE_IDS in src/feature-policy/feature-policy.ts in step.

features.description: Hides "Add Backend" in the backend selector menu (sidebar, expanded and collapsed).
